title: CabbageFarmSihti: from continuous world extrapolation to stochastic transfer law
summary: CabbageFarmSihti recombines the old CabbageFarm ambition of coordinate-addressable, effectively unbounded 2-D worlds with the Sihti/Sihti2 view that an operator can be inferred from what survives and bleeds out across scales. v0 begins with a stationary Gaussian spectral attacker. Site Gate 1 then keeps a coarse parent and asks whether its local frame can causally organize fresh fine-scale noise, with a shuffled-parent/wrong-address control. Gate 2 exposes phase-warp banding as a carrier artifact and separates the parent-conditioned relation from the chosen sine/multi-sine/phase-noise carrier. The repo therefore becomes a cheap visual control laboratory for provenance binding, carrier-versus-relation separation, and low-order statistical nulls that now transfer directly to AInsteinInsideTransformerResidualStream.

nodes.claim: Uses continuous implicit neural functions to represent a finite 2-D image as a coordinate-queryable field and extrapolate beyond the observed image.
nodes.survived: The coordinate-field formulation makes pan/zoom and arbitrary-coordinate queries a concrete engineering target; the repo also explores dense complex-valued and fast Walsh-Hadamard spectral mixing.
nodes.killed: Querying outside the fitted image does not by itself establish that the model learned a stochastic law of the texture or world; the README itself describes far extrapolation as hallucination.

nodes.claim: Learns and attacks multiscale transfer laws from finite textures: first a stationary spectral Gaussian law, then coarse-parent-conditioned fresh detail with explicit wrong-address and carrier-family controls.
nodes.survived: v0 implements reference-to-spectral-law fitting, fresh random Fourier synthesis, exact overlap-consistent coordinate crops and explicit second-order claim boundaries. Site Gate 1 shows the mechanism-level distinction between correct-parent conditioning and shuffled-parent/wrong-address binding while holding fresh-noise supply comparable. Gate 2 makes the carrier visible as a separate causal component: changing frame smoothing and sine/multi-sine/phase-noise carriers tests whether parent-conditioned organization survives after the conspicuous phase-warp stripes are removed.
nodes.killed: Matching power spectrum or linear octave-energy statistics is not treated as natural-texture equivalence. A recognizable reconstruction is not counted as object generation because the real coarse field is retained. Strong phase-warp banding is not evidence of a learned natural-image law: the carrier can dominate the visible result and must be attacked independently from the parent relation.

edges.why: CabbageFarmSihti explicitly revisits CabbageFarm's continuous/infinite-query world goal but replaces one-world implicit extrapolation with a stochastic-law-plus-noise generator.
CabbageFarmSihti explicitly imports the Sihti2 transfer-law/noise perspective: noise supplies novelty, while the learned operator and residue hierarchy describe what structure survives across scales.

The later site gates use Sihti's residue-as-departure view directly: keep the coarse survivor, regrow fresh residue conditionally, and attack whether the parent/residue relation survives wrong-address binding and carrier changes.

motifs.title: Learn the law, not one stored world
motifs.description: CabbageFarm made a continuous coordinate representation of one fitted image. Sihti2 reframed random input as a probe of an operator-written geometry. CabbageFarmSihti combines those lines by learning a stochastic transfer law from a finite example and applying it to fresh coordinate-addressable noise, so new territory comes from the law rather than from extrapolating one stored instance.
